findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which increases the risk associated with long-term use of a single cryptographic key, such as greater exposure if the key material is ever compromised.

No key policy is defined for this KMS key, so AWS applies the default policy granting full access to the entire AWS account (root), which can allow any IAM principal with sufficient IAM permissions to use or manage the key, weakening access control over encryption of sensitive log data.
